rps.description: Maximum requests per second for the user

burst_size.description: Request burst size; 0 defaults to rps

tokens_per_min.description: Maximum LLM tokens per minute for the user

model_limits.description: Per-model token quotas for the user

model.description: Model name the quota applies to

tokens_per_min.description: Maximum LLM tokens per minute for this user and model; 0 removes the model quota

items.description: One model's token quota inside a user's rate-limit entry. A nonempty model name is required; identities and models containing '|' or a reserved scope prefix are rejected (they would alias another bucket).
